competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease its Defense and Attack Power for 1 turn with a 25% chance each.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.

competences.description: Attacks and stuns the enemy for 1 turn with an 80% chance. Decreases the Attack Bar by 50% if the target already has a harmful effect.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

effets.note: If the target already has a harmful effect

competences.description: Increases your Attack Bar by 20% whenever an ally, excluding yourself, is attacked. In addition, steals 1 beneficial effect from the enemy target when you attack the enemy. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: whenever an ally, excluding yourself, is attacked

effets.description: Remove a beneficial effect and take it for yourself
